description: This PHP class 'SelectedFilterFieldDecorator' acts as a decorator for the SelectedFilterField entity within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manipulate and set filter fields based on IDs. It leverages traits and related entities to extend functionality in the HRM system's filtering feature.

classes.name: SelectedFilterFieldDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for SelectedFilterField entity, providing methods to set filter fields by ID, and utilizing ORM helper traits for entity reference management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a SelectedFilterField entity.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the contained SelectedFilterField entity.

methods.name: setFilterFieldById
methods.description: Sets the filter field of the entity based on the provided ID, using ORM reference retrieval.
